dct_description_sm: In marine ecosystems zooplankton are the link between primary production and higher tropic levels (i.e. fish and mammals). In order to characterize the vertical and spatial distribution of this fundamental component of the Beaufort Sea marine trophic system,  zooplankton samples were collected across both longitudinal and latitudinal gradient across the Canadian Beaufort Sea during the 2012 BREA marine fishes expedition.
dct_title_s: Beaufort Regional Environmental Assessment (BREA) Marine Fishes Project - Zooplankton collected data collected from the Canadian Beaufort Sea August to September 2012.
